info.title: C48 Response API
info.description: Public emergency request intake. Human-readable messages are Vietnamese; clients branch on stable error codes. SELF requests accept guests and optionally authenticated Web or Native callers; PROXY requests require an active Identity session.

get.description: Defaults to the NORMAL lane, except overdue=true without an explicit review_lane includes all lanes. Queue coordinates are rounded to about 100 m and phone numbers are masked.

post.description: A guest must provide X-Tracking-Secret. Cookie-authenticated writes require an allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Soft rate limits retain the report for review; the hard per-IP Nginx ceiling rejects it before persistence.

A human coordinator records an immutable review snapshot. Acceptance updates approved facts; rejection leaves them unchanged. Both outcomes increment the request version and notify the reporter.

post.description: Requires a live Identity session and stores the affected household's location and provenance. The affected person needs no account or phone. Open-cap and daily soft-limit excesses are stored in PROXY_QUOTA_REVIEW; staff activity flags are informational only.

get.description: A valid tracking capability receives only reporter-visible events without Identity; an authenticated staff caller with REQUEST_DETAIL_READ receives the paginated staff timeline. Related request IDs are scope-filtered.

The capability was revoked; proof is still required for claim or recovery.

post.summary: Issue a one-time reporter recovery code
post.description: Requires REQUEST_VERIFY in scope and an independently recorded successful reporter contact. The plaintext code is returned once; an idempotent replay returns issuance metadata only.

201.description: One-time plaintext recovery code and expiry.

200.description: Request linked to the active reporter; the recovery code and old capability are consumed.

post.summary: Attach one validated evidence file to a request
post.description: Requires Content-Length. Accepts JPEG/PNG up to 10 MiB or an MP4 container up to 50 MiB. Storage failure leaves the request unchanged.

get.summary: Get a short-lived evidence download URL

200.description: Signed URL expires within 60 seconds; bucket stays private.

get.summary: Suggest eligible teams for a request
get.description: Read-only suggestions scoped by MISSION_ASSIGN. Active-mission teams are omitted. Fresh positions within radius are ranked by priority band, recent workload, distance, and team id; missing, stale, or future positions appear in unknown_position. Exactly one team is suggested when items is nonempty; no team is suggested when items is empty, even if unknown_position contains teams. Exact team coordinates and external contact details are never returned.

200.description: Eligible team candidates and the parameters used for ranking.

put.description: APP team leaders may report GPS or manual-pin positions for their own team. Scoped coordinators with TEAM_POSITION_SET_ANY may report COORDINATOR_REPORTED positions. Updates within 15 seconds or moving less than 25 meters are suppressed; writes return no content and are not idempotency-keyed.

get.summary: List missions for the active member teams
get.description: Available to active team members. Reporter contacts are included for the assigned team leader only.

200.description: Missions of the caller’s active teams.

get.description: Requires MISSION_OVERDUE_READ in request scope. An overdue offer is a flag for coordinators and is never automatically reassigned.

get.summary: Get a mission and its timeline
get.description: Available to active assigned-team members or a caller with scoped REQUEST_DETAIL_READ. Member views contain only this mission’s approved snapshot, timeline, and evidence; contacts are leader-only.

post.description: Active APP team leader only.

post.summary: Record a mission update on behalf of a team
post.description: Requires MISSION_RECORD_ON_BEHALF in the request scope. DECLINED is supported for accountless COORDINATOR teams.

TrackingSecret.name: X-Tracking-Secret
TrackingSecret.description: Required for a guest. It is purpose-bound hashed at rest and never returned.

RequiredTrackingSecret.name: X-Tracking-Secret
RequiredTrackingSecret.description: Required proof for claiming a guest request; never sent as Authorization.

TrackingCodeHeader.name: X-Tracking-Code
TrackingCodeHeader.description: Never place the tracking code in a URL.

RecoveryCode.name: X-Recovery-Code
RecoveryCode.description: Purpose-bound, one-time recovery proof; never logged or returned after issuance.

IdempotentReplay.description: Present as true when this response replays the original command result.

CacheControlNoStore.description: Prevents storage of the Response API result.

Error.description: Vietnamese error message; clients branch on the stable code.

SosRateCeiling.description: The hard per-IP limit rejected the request before it was persisted.

accuracy_m.description: Required with captured_at for GPS; must be omitted for MANUAL_PIN.

recovery_code.description: Only present in the original issuance response; omitted by replay.

subject.description: Scoped staff-only exact location and contact details.
